notes.note: CC00 starts COSGN00C: with no COMMAREA it sends the sign-on map; on ENTER it reads the user from USRSEC and, when the password matches, transfers to COADM01C for an admin user and to COMEN01C otherwise; PF3 sends a thank-you text. The screen after a failed sign-on is the sign-on map again with a message.

The main menu sends its map on first entry and, on ENTER, transfers to the program of the option keyed (options 1-11 of COMEN02Y); PF3 goes back to the sign-on program. Which screen follows is therefore the operator's choice - unknown at analysis time.

The admin menu sends its map on first entry and, on ENTER, transfers to the program of the option keyed (options 1-6 of COADM02Y: four user-maintenance programs and COTRTLIC / COTRTUPC, which are outside this module's scan); PF3 goes back to the sign-on program.

CORPT00C submits the report job by writing its JCL records to TD queue JOBS; the scheduled batch chains bracket their work with CLOSEFIL/OPENFIL, which close and reopen TRANSACT, CCXREF, ACCTDAT, CXACAIX and USRSEC in the region - a job submitted from this screen is not bracketed by them.
